en.topic_title: Over 93% of Wang Fuk Court homeowners sign sales agreement for gov’t buyback scheme
en.topic_summary:
Over 93 per cent of Wang Fuk Court homeowners have signed a formal sales agreement to sell their flats to the government as part of a buyout scheme following the deadly fire almost a year ago.



Wang Fuk Court on May 4, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



A total of 1,850 homeowners from the Tai Po estate have completed the Agreement for Sale and Purchase (ASP), the government said on Friday.
